propositions: True bug-escape rate and detection-stage efficiency cannot be calculated because only 1.1% of current bugs carry detected_by metadata, preventing a validated denominator for defect observability.

Plan review first-pass rate is 49.0% with median 2 attempts and p90 8 attempts, requiring 114.72 LLM calls per eventual completion-PASS; deterministic preflight checks could reduce churn before semantic review.

Completion first-pass verdict is 72.3% overall, 79.7% for tickets with Testing section headings, and 74.2% with declared file impact, suggesting structured metadata correlates with quality signals but does not prove causation.

Commit governance hygiene (ticket trailers, DCO, Change-Id) improved from 0% in Q2 to 90.4%, 82.9%, and 99.3% respectively by Q3, establishing process maturation during the measurement window but confounding causal comparison.

35 source modules are at or above 720 LOC including 4 above 780 LOC; median source-change size declined from 111.5 to 95 lines Q2→Q3 while test co-change increased, but duplication remains at 4.09% and same-file retouch suggests hotspot concentration.

Author/bot concentration accounts for 92.4% of commits and Gerrit code-review first-pass is 97.4%, but reviewer independence, force-bypass frequency, and defect escape by review outcome were not measured.
